evidence.message: The full audit reported 32 findings. A later audit confirmed the missing alert credential fix and listed 31 open findings.
Rechecked the baseline and began examining the outstanding deployment, recovery, data and worker findings.
An encrypted backup restored all 321 signed receipts. The live baseline query uses its verified index. The locked observer passed the host deployment suite.
The rollout exposed a worker readiness failure under the credential launcher. The fix passed seven Linux tests and the live deployment retry.
The host validated 117 controls on pull request 45. It closed 31 of the original 32 findings. Live disk and swap encryption remains a medium finding.
Matt chose to keep the current storage. The encryption finding remains open. The encrypted off-host snapshots and isolated restore were verified.
The deployment exposed a line ending mismatch. All ten Linux service templates now have identical archive bytes on Windows and Linux.
The deployed release passed 494 host tests. An isolated restore verified all 369 signed receipts. The full audit closed 31 findings and records the storage decision.
Eight historical audits completed. Seven GitHub checks matched their receipts. The full audit of PR 43 preserved the repository baseline at 253ab19e.
PR 50 merged after seven checks passed. Its PR and full audits completed, and the GitHub audit check matched the saved receipt.
Across 1,007 host samples, available memory stayed above 16 GiB. Four logged webhook submissions were too few to establish p99 latency.
The BWS-only restore verified 415 signed witnesses and SQLite in 9.25 seconds. The webhook and worker kept serving throughout the drill.
A scheduled six-hour backup recorded zero pause. The 9.70-second restore verified SQLite and 467 witness signatures. PR 55 passed both audits.
The Intel Mac refreshed the verified snapshot and recovered 44 audits and 130 reports offline. Its pinned observer image passed 12 tests. Public failover remains open.
Two signed GitHub deliveries recovered their original jobs. Three local voters fenced a delayed test publication. Both hosts passed the same observer policy.
Taskmaster read 45 live attempts across 35 heads and matched 28 gate receipts. The schema-v3 loopback reader started without restarting the worker or receiver.
The Intel Mac ran three mTLS voters and two origins. The surviving receiver returned 200 in all 55 samples. The return transfer preserved private state and signed receipts.
